ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The figure below is “a map of a certain region in the eastern monsoon area of our country.” Read the figure and answer the question. <image1> What may be the main factors affecting the distribution characteristics of cities in the northern region?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: the legend shows that circles represent “county-level and above cities,” and the figure also marks traffic lines such as national highways, expressways, and railways. Observing the northern part of the figure, the city points are not evenly dispersed, but are more concentrated and arranged along curved linear natural elements and narrow corridors. By comparison, the distribution of cities in the south is more obviously connected with traffic lines. Reasoning: the question asks about the main influencing factors of the “distribution characteristics of cities in the northern region.” The northern cities show a pattern of concentration along lines and along valleys, indicating that their distribution is controlled by natural conditions: rivers can provide water sources and passage corridors, while terrain restricts flat construction land, causing cities to be mostly distributed in river valleys or relatively flat areas. Therefore the main factors affecting the distribution characteristics of cities in the northern region may be terrain and rivers.

method.method_draft: 先读图例，确认圆圈表示县级及以上城市，交通线包括国道、高速公路和铁路；再观察图中北部，城市点多沿弯曲的自然线状要素和狭长通道分布，而不是均匀散布。结合题干“北部地区城市分布特点”，判断这种沿线、沿谷集中的格局通常受河流提供水源与通道、地形限制平坦建设用地共同影响。因此概括为地形和河流。
